Etymology tree
Arabic تَجَاوَزَ (tajāwaza)
Arabic تَجَاوُز (tajāwuz)bor.
Azerbaijani təcavüz
Borrowed from Arabic تَجَاوُز (tajāwuz), from تَجَاوَزَ (tajāwaza).
From Proto-Common Turkic *top-ïk. By surface analysis, top (“round thing; ball”) + -uq.
Borrowed from Arabic يَوْم الثُّلَاثَاء (yawm aṯ-ṯulāṯāʔ).
